note: No rule of the Central Bank of Barbados fixing one length was read; the Central Bank's own guide, Barbados Local Transfers Instructions: Account Format Details for Successful Online Transfers (dated June 22, 2026, read 2026-10-30; it says its information was sourced from each participant), gives each participant's own: RBC Royal Bank a 5-digit branch transit and a 7-digit account (given separately or joined, transit first, as twelve digits); Scotiabank's accounts originally 1 to 9 digits (1 to 8 at the former Independence Square), now 8 or 9 with a branch prefix; First Citizens 11 digits in all instances; Sagicor 10; Republic Bank 12 in all instances; the Central Bank, the Accountant General and the Stock Exchange 6; the credit unions' numbers entered as they are, with no leading zeros (the Public Workers credit union's example is five digits, padded to ten only where a sender's system requires it); CIBC Caribbean's length isn't given. So the number is written as an account number of up to twelve digits, the longest the guide gives, and no shortest is fixed, since the guide sets none (credit unions' numbers have no leading zeros, and Scotiabank's began at one digit). No drawn length is given: a new account is drawn at twelve, Republic Bank's length; which bank is the largest wasn't read. The receiving bank is named beside the number (by its BIC, and RBC's and the Central Bank's by a transit), not inside it, and no check digit is published.

sources.title: Central Bank of Barbados, Barbados Local Transfers Instructions: Account Format Details for Successful Online Transfers (June 22, 2026)
sources.said: Account Format Details for Successful Online Transfers ... Branch Transit Number — a 5-digit number that identifies the RBC branch where your account is held ... Account Number — a 7-digit number unique to your account ... This is a general guide that has information which has been sourced from each Participant ... Most account numbe rs were originally between 1 and 9 digits in length. ... resulting in an 8 - or 9-digit account number format ... Enter the account number as is, e.g., 23789; no leading zeros are required ... Account numbers are comprised of 11 digits in all instances — no transit number required . ... Account numbers are comprised of ten (10) digits . ... Account numbers are comprised of 12 digits in all instances — separate and distinct from branch codes . ... Account numbers are comprised of 6 digits .
